items.title: Modern Geometric Broken Ladder Asymmetric Gate Pattern
items.description: A minimalist, high-concept industrial panel featuring a single curved ladder-like segment made of thick rectangular links on a solid dark field. The abstract design relies on a bold contrast between negative space and solid material for a clean look.
